author: Giglioli, 1884

note.en: A small silvery grenadier of the upper slope below about 100 m; only a regional record.
note.es: Un granadero plateado pequeño de la pendiente superior, desde unos 100 m; solo un registro regional.

evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic, with no local sighting reports found
recWhy: Deep-slope fish with only a FishBase listing for Costa Rica.

marks.en: Silvery body with a big, glassy-looking head and a long tail tapering to a point.
marks.es: Cuerpo plateado con cabeza grande de aspecto vítreo y una cola larga que termina en punta.
